products.notes: Phoenix Gold manual. Inputs: 6 RCA (max 4 Vrms at 0 dB attenuation, 8 Vrms at max attenuation) + 8 high-level (33 ohm load, max 20 Vrms) + 3.5 mm aux + phone/nav + micro-USB + Wi-Fi + Toslink (24/96). Outputs: 8 RCA (max 5 Vrms, 50 ohm) + Toslink out. 30-band 1/3-oct parametric EQ per channel (240 total). Delay 0-5 m / 14.6 ms in 0.01 ms steps. Crossover HP/LP/BP 0-30 dB/oct BW/Bessel/LR. S/N >103 dBA RCA/AUX, >110 digital; THD 0.01% analog. ADI 64-bit Sigma DSP; internal rate not stated. DSP8.8 configurator (iOS/Android/Mac/Windows) + DSP RC app; DRC remote.
